verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, an OpenAPI 3.1 description intended for code generators, and an official CLI that can call any REST endpoint. None of these is an official SDK library. They are developer building blocks or adjacent tooling from which a user could construct a client, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The same description is available as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON for code generators
`cafe api <path>` sends an authenticated request to any REST API endpoint.
